sample_mapping_evidence: Primary PMID38394230 Figure7 confirms four adult PBMC donors, two male/two female. Original F1/F2/M1/M2 IL-2 control records selected as canonical observations. Paired activation aliquots do not add physical blood specimens; cord blood and mouse sources excluded. Preserve ex-vivo and lineage restrictions.

source_processing: The raw FASTQ data was processed using Cell Ranger v3.0.1
Count matrixes were filtered using Seurat v4.0.1 to remove cell barcodes with less than 700 genes and with more than 15% mitochondrial counts
Seurat v4.0.1 was used to normalize, scale, regress out variation in UMI counts and mitochondrial content, perform dimensionality reduction and generate UMAP projections.

Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files; containing cell barcodes, genes, and matricies which can be combined to form a Barcodes X Features sparse count matrix for each sample.

title: IL-2 Adult F1 [scRNA-seq]
extract_protocol_ch1: CD8+ cells were magnetically enriched by positive selection (anti-human CD8 microbeads; Miltenyi Biotech) from rested PBMCs or CBMCs. 2x105 cells were plated per well in round-bottomed 96 well plates. Cells were incubated in RP-10 supplemented with recombinant human IL-2, recombinant human IL-12p70 and recombinant human IL-18 at 10ng/ml for 18-22 hours. Live CD235a- CD4- CD8+ cells were sorted into 0.04% BSA in PBS.

Cells were counted and 3-8k cells per sample were loaded in the Chromium controller for the formation of gel bead-in-emulsions (GEMs) following the manufacturer's instructions (10X Genomics). The single-cell RNA-seq libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 3′ Reagent Kit v3 following the accompanied protocol and were sequenced on Illumina NextSeq500.
